text: Labels a short review positive or negative from the words it uses: negative when it has more negative words (bad, terrible, hate, awful, sad, poor, horrible, bland) than positive ones (good, great, love, excellent, happy, nice, amazing, tasty), positive otherwise.
example_input: {"text": "The food was terrible and the service was bad"}
expected_behaviour: Returns 200 with label negative; "I love this great place" returns label positive.
